primary_products.value: AI solution design software; benchmarking and best-practice databases; enterprise software licenses

primary_services.value: Performance benchmarking; executive advisory; business process transformation; enterprise software implementation and support; custom AI development

customer_segment.value: B2B: Large enterprises and their finance, procurement, human resources, and technology teams

end_markets.value: Manufacturing; financial services; retail and consumer goods; technology; healthcare

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Benchmarking studies, business transformation, software implementation, and custom AI development; subscription: Recurring access to executive advisory, research, and benchmarking tools; licensing or royalties: Access to proprietary software and licenses for third-party enterprise applications; service fees: Ongoing enterprise application support and maintenance
revenue_model.category: project or contract; subscription; licensing or royalties; service fees
